stem.text: The graph shows how the rate of entry of glucose into a cell changes as the concentration of glucose outside the cell changes.

stem.alt: Graph: vertical axis 'rate of entry of glucose into the cell', horizontal axis 'concentration of glucose outside the cell'; curve rises then levels off, with a bracket labelled X over the level part.
stem.label: X

stem.text: What is the cause of the plateau at X?

A.text: All the carrier proteins are saturated with glucose.

B.text: The carrier proteins are denatured and no longer able to function.

C.text: The cell has used up its supply of ATP.

D.text: The concentrations of glucose inside and outside the cell are equal.
